text.jp:
なにー？
アタシに頼みたいコトでもあるのー？
text.official_en: Yeah? Got something you wanna ask me?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン

text.jp:
いいよー。軍務に支障ないなら好きにしろって、
セオドラさまも言ってたしー。
text.official_en:
Ask, then. Queen Theodora said I could do whatever
as long as it doesn't interfere with my military duties.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン

text.jp:
でも、アタシは高いよー？
もちろんその分、役に立つケドねー。
text.official_en:
My services aren't cheap, but you get what you
pay for.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
はいはーい。
じゃあ、これからお世話になるからねー。
text.official_en:
Alrighty. Looks like I'll be working with you from
now on.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
報酬払ってくれるなら、
しっかり真面目に働いたげるよー。
text.official_en:
Pay me fairly, and I guarantee you'll be happy with
my work.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
交渉決裂だねー。
あーあ、新しい稼ぎ口になると思ったのになー。
text.official_en:
So much for negotiations. Damn...and here I'd hoped
this could be a new income source for me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン

text.jp:
へー、声をかけられることなんて、
あんまないんだケド、結構嬉しいかもー？
text.official_en:
Y'know, I don't get too many offers like this, but it's
kinda nice.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも生憎さ、アタシ、セオドラさまに仕えてるんだ。
だからこの話は無かったってコトで。ゴメンねー！
text.official_en:
Too bad I'm in Queen Theodora's service. So let's
forget the whole thing. Sorry!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
へえ、仲間に誘ってくれるんだ？
弓が上手いから？　そりゃどーも。
text.official_en:
Oh, you want me to join you? Because I'm good with
a bow? Aw, thanks.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン

text.jp:
アタシ、セオドラさまのお付きでさー、
そっちでお給金貰って、働いてるワケ。
text.official_en: But I'm on Queen Theodora's payroll right now.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
でも、もっともっとお金がいるんだよねー。
だから、そっちの仕事を手伝ってもいいよ。
text.official_en:
That said...I never turn down a payday. So I don't
mind helping you out on the side.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_リリアン

text.jp:
で、契約金はどれくらいもらえるの？
言っとくケド、アタシ、高いよー？
text.official_en:
What can you offer me as a down payment? I'll let
you know now, I don't work cheap.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

い……いいの、こんなに？
やったー！　言ってみるもんだねー！
text.official_en:
Uh, seriously? That much? Sweet! I guess it really
doesn't hurt to ask.

ま、期待しててよ！

I'll work as hard as you pay me for. And for that
much, I'll work pretty hard!

Huh? Not even gonna haggle? Damn...I was hoping
this would be a new source of income.
